newsitem.title: UK: Wickes sales up in first six months of 97.
newsitem.headline: Wickes sales up in first six months of 97.

text.p: Wickes Plc, the home improvement products retailer, said on Monday its like-for-like UK retail sales were up 12 percent during the first six months of this year.
Wickes said that first quarter like-for-like growth was up 17 percent and second quarter up seven percent.
"The board views prospects for the year as a whole with increased confidence," said the company in a statement.

It said that the DIY market has continued to grow ahead of inflation so far this year, but added that the economic background and the development of the housing market and interest rates in particular have yet to be fully reassessed following the change to a Labour government in May.
